jordan l: quick note from onboarding run: brought up 7B-mix (q4_k + selective int8) with a two-stage speculative decoder (`--spec-two-stage`). baseline fp16 p50=48ms, this run p50=36ms (~25% improvement).

mei z: nice. which eval sets and sampling config?

jordan l: ran TriviaQA-open, squad2 dev, and lambada-perplex. cmd: `./eval.sh --model weights/7b-mix --spec-mode two-stage --spec-stage2-size 8 --topk 30 --temp 0.7 --batch 16 --seq 512 --evalsets triviaqa,squad2,lambada`

pranav r: metrics? any quality regressions?

jordan l: short summary (A100 dev pool): p50 36ms (48ms baseline), p95 120ms (145ms baseline), tokens/sec +28%. TriviaQA EM baseline 72.4 -> 71.0 (delta -1.4). SQuAD2 F1 baseline 88.1 -> 87.6 (delta -0.5). Lambada perplexity baseline 6.9 -> 7.3 (+0.4).

mei z: Trivia drop is noteworthy. Did you use sampling or greedy?

jordan l: sampling for TriviaQA (topk/temp above). greedy for lambada perplexity.

pranav r: could be that stage-1 candidates are biased toward high-prob tokens and stage-2 rescoring doesn't apply correct sampling posterior. Did you log candidate scores and the final merged distribution?

jordan l: yes I dumped candidate sets and merged logits at `/var/tmp/spec-two-stage-dumps/7380001001/`. example dump format is flat jsonlines with fields: prompt_id, candidates_stage1, candidates_stage2, merged_logits, final_probs.

ci-bot: CI note: spec-two-stage flag landed on staging canary at 7380001065 (3 pods).

mei z: run these quick ablations: 1) sampling temp sweep (0.4, 0.7, 1.0) 2) stage2-size=0 (disable stage2) 3) apply temperature-rescale to stage1 logits before merge 4) compute KL(merged || baseline) per-token and report mean.

jordan l: running temp sweep now. first pass results: temp 0.4 -> Trivia EM 70.8, temp 0.7 -> 71.0, temp 1.0 -> 70.5 (noise but consistent drop). stage2-size=0 (only stage1 candidates) -> EM 71.9 (closer to baseline). rescale stage1 by inverse-temp (logits /= temp) before merge -> EM 72.2 (within noise of baseline). KL(mean) between merged and baseline fell from 0.28 -> 0.05 after rescale.

pranav r: that KL change is telling. suggests stage1 logits were being treated as raw scores instead of tempered. rescale seems to fix. how's perf with rescale?

jordan l: perf hit tiny: p50 37ms (vs 36ms), tokens/sec -2%. good trade.

mei z: add a simple regularizer in the runtime: when merging prefetched logits, apply `logit_stage1 = logit_stage1 / effective_temp` where effective_temp = max(global_temp, 0.5) to avoid overcorrection. also add a cap on stage1-logit delta: clamp at +3.0 above top.

pranav r: agree. also try importance-weighted rescore: compute weights w_i proportional to exp((logits_stage2 - logits_stage1)/temp) and normalize. may better reflect stage2 evidence. can be a follow-up experiment.

jordan l: created a quick patch with rescale + clamp. test eval (rescale+clamp): Trivia EM 72.1, SQuAD2 F1 88.0, Lambada PPL 6.95. Perf: p50 37ms.

ops-bot: rollout guard created RB-1510 by mei.z at 7380001102 (disable spec-two-stage for models with tag "fresh-quant").

ci-bot: PR: https://git.redwood/inference/pull/3188 (spec-two-stage: rescale + clamp + unit tests)  test-run: all unit tests passed.

mei z: please add a unit-test that verifies merged softmax under multiple temps equals a reference emulation (python sim). also add an integration smoke that checks KL < 0.1 vs baseline for canary models.

jordan l: added tests in PR. ran integration smoke on a small 200-prompt holdout: KL mean 0.04, Trivia EM 72.0. CI is running full evals.

pranav r: good. next: instrument runtime to emit a small histogram metric for per-token KL(merged||baseline) so we can catch regressions during canary runs. put metric on per-route dashboard.

jordan l: added metric: spec.merge.kl.binned and a route-level alert if meanKL > 0.15 for 10m.

mei z: ops: when gating canary, keep guard enabled for any model with label "quant-new" until meanKL < 0.08 and end-to-end eval deltas within noise.

ops-bot: canary plan noted in RB-1510. scheduled small canary on dedicated-dev cluster at 7380001150 (50 req/s).

ci-bot: full eval finished: TriviaQA EM patched 72.0 (baseline 72.4), delta -0.4; SQuAD2 F1 patched 87.9 (baseline 88.1), delta -0.2; Lambada PPL patched 6.96 (baseline 6.9). p50 37ms. all within acceptance thresholds defined in docs/quality_gates.md.

jordan l: will merge after ops confirms canary looks stable. thanks for the fast turnaround.

mei z: nice work. short takeaways: two-stage speculative decoding gives solid perf wins, but must correct stage1 logits for sampling temperature before merge; simple clamp + rescale recovers quality with minimal perf cost.

pranav r: filed follow-ups: 1) importance-weighted rescoring eval (PR 3192), 2) production telemetry dashboard for spec.merge.kl, 3) run same checks on 13B quant variants.

ops-bot: canary started at 7380001155. monitoring metrics exported.

ci-bot: CI status: all checks passed at 7380001118.

jordan l: merging now. will post post-canary numbers in this thread later. :party_popper:
